epistemic_purpose: repair stale live Backgrounded + Cancel projection after authoritative CommandJob terminality

verdict_history.summary: Multi-job production projection bug: the runner fired onBackgroundStateChange(false, undefined) ONLY on the >0->0 cardinal flip. When J1 terminalized while J2 stayed running, no callback fired; J1's projection stayed 'running' forever (stale Backgrounded pill bug).

Bounded repair moves the per-job terminal signal UPSTREAM to the runner (carrying jobId + terminalState, NOT gated on becameIdle). Controller projection maintains the per-job map, derives the scalar from it, computes the active taskId as the LAST running entry. BTCONT predicate fires exactly once on the >0->0 transition.
Adds BCTCP-RUNNER-MULTI-01..04 at the production seam: real createVscodeRunCommandsTool + real createVscodeShellExecutor + real CommandJobManager.start. RED captured against predecessor e588d0541.

Round 2 closes the start-side asymmetry: the runner was still gated on aggregate 0->1 cardinality (`if (start.becameActive)`), so a concurrent J2 start after J1 dropped J2's start signal entirely. The per-job projection map never saw J2 === 'running', breaking `backgroundCommandRunning` and `backgroundCommandTaskId`. Production fix at vscode-run-commands-tool.ts:813-834: the runner now fires `(true, start.jobId)` UNCONDITIONALLY for every RUNNING start. Symmetric with the terminal side already corrected in round 1. Also wires the SdkController lambda at line 1448 to forward the third argument (terminalState) so the per-job reason actually reaches the projection map. Three pass-through surface types (vscode-runtime-builder / vscode-session-host / sdk-session-lifecycle) updated to accept the third arg. New tests: BCTCP-RUNNER-MULTI-00 (start-per-job invariant -- exactly one (true, J1) and exactly one (true, J2), no (true, undefined), no drops) AND BCTCP-RUNNER-COMPOSITION-01 (full producer -> bridge -> consumer composition the Factory reviewer demanded: real runner callbacks drive real SdkController.updateBackgroundCommandState end-to-end; J1+J2 start -> both projection entries; J1 cancel -> J1=cancelled, J2=running, scalar=true, taskId=J2; J2 cancel -> J2=cancelled, scalar=false, taskId=undefined).

runner_seam_red_witnesses.BCTCP-RUNNER-MULTI-00: start J1 + J2 -> spy receives exactly [true, J1, undefined] and [true, J2, undefined] (per-job, no drops, no (true, undefined))

runner_seam_red_witnesses.BCTCP-RUNNER-MULTI-02: start J1 + J2, cancel J1 then J2 -> per-job tuple for BOTH, no (false, undefined) leak
runner_seam_red_witnesses.BCTCP-RUNNER-MULTI-03: composed runner -> projection map: J1=cancelled, J2=running
runner_seam_red_witnesses.BCTCP-RUNNER-MULTI-04: runner NEVER fires (false, undefined) while a sibling is running
